name: frenzy
description: FRENZY: a fish-eat-fish arena played for ETH on Robinhood Chain. Three packages, no workspaces: web/ (Next), server/ (the referee), contracts/ (Hardhat).

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix contracts install
scripts.test: npm --prefix web run sim && npm --prefix contracts test
scripts.check: npm --prefix web run lint && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix server run typecheck
